name: Captron Electronics Assembly
old_description: If you just have an idea or concept or you have completed schematics, we can convert them in to manufacturable design files followed by PCB manufacturing, Assembly and Testing.
about:
CapTron Corporation was established in 1997 in Gaithersburg, Maryland. The company began as an electronic manufacturing services provider focused on printed circuit boards, assemblies, and complete systems.

The shop offers a full turnkey suite: PCB design and layout, fabrication of single-sided, double-sided, and multi-layer boards for analog, digital, and RF applications, and PCB assembly with part procurement, programming, BGA placement with X-ray inspection, and functional testing. It also produces custom cable assemblies, box builds, and enclosure machining. CapTron handles quick-turn prototypes through production quantities, though specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

Customers span communications device manufacturers, internet service providers, automotive component makers, and RF technology firms. The company works with OEMs and other businesses needing flexible, responsive electronic contract manufacturing.

CapTron emphasizes flexible service, firm up-front pricing, straight talk, and ethical practices. It avoids one-size-fits-all solutions, instead developing customized programs for each client. Quality is positioned as non-negotiable, with no shortcuts that compromise solder joints or component placement.
